depiction.primary_object: Bluetooth rune symbol with two right-pointing triangles
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the intersecting diagonal lines of the rune and the slash can look like an abstract geometric mark or a flash-off icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: disabled, turned off, disconnected, or broken

reasoning: Shows the standard Bluetooth rune crossed out with a diagonal slash, universally meaning Bluetooth off, disconnected, or unpair. It fits a narrow but real set of tech troubleshooting and device-cleanup tasks (unpairing old cars/speakers, fixing dropouts, disabling wireless radios), though it must not be used when a specific device like headphones or a speaker is the central object.
